$comment: Intended differences between the Next.js baseline and the bespoke build.
Every rule needs a `reason`. `pattern` and `routes` are substrings, or
`re:<javascript regexp>`. `kind` is head | text | html | file | route.
diff-html.ts prints rules that matched nothing, so stale entries surface.
This file is intentionally EMPTY of content rules for Phase 0: the
baseline must diff clean against itself with no exceptions at all.
Phase 1+ agents add rules here as intended divergences land.
